page.title: AI Marketing Agency: What They Do and When to Hire One
page.description: Learn what an AI marketing agency delivers, how it differs from consultants, which tools and workflows it runs, and how to evaluate cost and fit for your team.
page.h1: AI marketing agency: what it does and when to hire one
page.definition: An AI marketing agency is a service provider that builds and runs human-in-the-loop automation for research, content production, creative testing, campaign execution and reporting using tools such as large language models, image generators and workflow platforms.
page.quick_answer: Hire an agency when you need working automations, integrations and documentation with ongoing support; use a consultant for an assessment, use-case list, tool choice and roadmap.

sections.h2: What does an AI marketing agency actually do?

blocks.p: An AI marketing agency builds and operates end-to-end workflows that combine generative models with human approval gates so output moves from draft to publish without manual handoffs.

ul: Research and brief drafting using large language models
Content production and repurposing across formats
Creative variant generation for ad and email testing
Campaign setup, scheduling and performance reporting
Workflow automation that connects research, creation, review and publishing

sections.h2: When should you hire an AI marketing agency versus build in-house?

blocks.p: Hire an agency when you need working automations, integrations and documentation with a support retainer; keep strategy, brand voice approval and product decisions in-house.

ol: You have repeatable content or campaign cycles that consume hours each week
Your team lacks prompt engineering, integration or automation expertise
You need cross-tool workflows that connect research, creation, review and analytics
You want a fixed build fee plus monthly retainer rather than open-ended consulting
You need human-in-the-loop governance without hiring a dedicated AI ops role

sections.h2: What tools and workflows do AI marketing agencies run?

blocks.p: Agencies standardise on a stack that covers workflow management, generation, image variants, hand-offs and reporting, with every step gated by a named approver.

sections.h2: How much does an AI marketing agency cost?

blocks.p: Pricing follows a fixed build fee plus a monthly retainer for ongoing support, unlike consultants who charge day rates or fixed project fees for assessments and roadmaps.

ul: Discovery and use-case prioritisation included in build phase
Automation build scoped per engagement with defined deliverables
Monthly retainer covers monitoring, updates and support hours
No published price list; send scope for a quote
West Peek Productions sets up human-in-the-loop AI workflows for marketing, content and event teams, scoped per engagement

sections.h2: How do you evaluate an AI marketing agency before signing?

blocks.p: Ask for a live walkthrough of a working automation, proof of human-in-the-loop gates, and a clear handoff plan so your team can own the system after launch.

ul: Show a complete workflow from brief to published asset with approval logs
Demonstrate integration with your existing project and analytics tools
Provide documentation standards and runbook examples
Clarify support SLAs, update cadence and escalation paths
Confirm they do not lock you into proprietary platforms or models

faq.q: What is the difference between an AI marketing consultant and an AI marketing agency?
faq.a: A consultant delivers an assessment, a prioritised use-case list, a tool choice and a roadmap. An agency delivers working automations, integrations and documentation, often with a support retainer. Consultants charge day rates or fixed project fees; agencies charge a fixed build fee plus a monthly retainer.

faq.q: Can an AI marketing agency replace my content team?
faq.a: No. The agency builds workflows that accelerate research, drafting and variant creation, but human-in-the-loop rules require a named person to approve every output. Strategy, brand voice approval and product decisions stay in-house while the agency handles execution automation and integration.

faq.q: What does human-in-the-loop mean in practice?
faq.a: AI output is a draft until a named person approves it. The agency sets up approval gates at each stage — brief, draft, variant, publish — so no content goes live without a recorded sign-off. This keeps compliance, brand and quality control inside your team.

faq.q: How long does it take to launch the first automated workflow?
faq.a: A first plan runs 90 days: long enough to see a trend, short enough to change course. The build phase typically takes several weeks depending on scope, integrations and approval cycles. West Peek Productions scopes each engagement separately and does not publish fixed timelines.
